newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-Pakistan six for two wickets v West Indies.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-Pakistan six for two wickets v West Indies.

text.p: West Indies captain Courtney Walsh struck again early in the second World Series limited overs final to have Pakistan six for two wickets after four overs.
Walsh combined with Brian Lara at first slip twice in his first two overs to have Pakistan reeling. In his first over Walsh had opener Shahid Afridi caught for a duck.
In his next over, the fourth of the match, Walsh had Zahoor Elahi caught by Lara without scoring.
Walsh had the figures of two for one run after two overs.
Opener Aamir Sohail was two not out and the new batsman was Ijaz Ahmed.
Pakistan captain Wasim Akram won the toss and elected to bat. Akram's side lead the best-of-three match series 1-0 after beating West Indies by four wickets in the first match on Saturday.
